author: jdsaire
governance_policy: Raster images approved through an image round (skill ai-studio-image-round). Each is AI-generated, art-directed and selected by jdsaire, and labelled on the page that shows it. It is never replaced by an SVG fallback, re-encoded or swapped without a new round and a manifest update. Theme-invariant: dark editorial in both themes.
label_rule: Every page that shows a listed asset carries the key named in label_key, visible, in the section that shows it (PR46-Q48).
method_note: Generated with an AI image model in an external round; the model and settings are kept in the round record outside the repository (PR42-Q37 pattern).

budgets.lcp_rule: No listed asset may be the LCP element of any page at 390 or 1440.
budgets.object_position_posters: 50% 0% (phone cards are 10:17, wider than 9:16: anchoring the top keeps the subject at or below its rendered height)
